meta.name: dnanexus-integration
meta.description: Build and operate reproducible genomics workloads on DNAnexus with the dx CLI, dxpy, apps/applets, native workflows, dxCompiler, and Nextflow. Use for DNAnexus data transfers, dxapp.json development, execution monitoring, workflow import, and project automation.

copy.tagline: 让基因组分析在云端标准化自动运行
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常批量跑测序分析,希望过程可复现且云端自动调度
copy.tagline_en: Automate reproducible genomics analyses in the cloud.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage many genomics analyses and need automated reproducible runs.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能协助你在 DNAnexus 云平台上传下载数据、构建并部署 app/applet、运行和监控作业、搭建工作流,处理 FASTQ/BAM/VCF 等文件。
howto.when: 当你要构建或修改 DNAnexus 应用、上传下载或检索数据、运行并监控作业与工作流时触发。

say.text: 查找 project-xxxx 下所有 .bam 文件并下载到本地
say.note: 按名称和属性检索后批量下载

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude can work on the DNAnexus cloud platform: upload and download data with the dx CLI and dxpy, build and deploy apps/applets, run and monitor jobs, and set up workflows for FASTQ/BAM/VCF files.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want to build or modify DNAnexus apps/applets, upload, download or search data, or run and monitor jobs and workflows.

say_en.text: Upload sample.fastq to project-xxxx and run an alignment job
say_en.note: Uploads via dxpy and launches the applet job

say_en.text: Generate a new app skeleton with dx-app-wizard and write dxapp.json
say_en.note: Creates app skeleton and config template

say_en.text: Find all .bam files in project-xxxx and download them locally
